outline:
機率空間；組合分析；聯合分佈隨機變數；動差函數及特徵函數；大數法則及中央極限定理。
This course is designed for students to get concepts and methods of Probability and Statistics.
schedule:
Week 1-4
Sample space and probability
- Sets
- Probabilistic Models
- Conditional Probability
- Total Probability Theorem and Bayes’ Rule
- Independence
- Counting

Week 5-8
Discrete random variables
- Basic Concepts
- Probability Mass Functions
- Functions of Random Variables
- Expectation, Mean, and Variance
- Joint PMFs of Multiple Random Variables
- Conditioning
- Independence

Week 9-14
General Random Variables:
- Continuous Random Variables and PDFs
- Cumulative Distribution Functions
- Normal Random Variables
- Joint PDFs of Multiple Random Variables
- Conditioning
- Independence

Week 15-16
Selected further topics

(課程內容與授課進度將視實際授課情況與學習狀況滾動式調整)

category: 學生分組實作及討論(Student group practice and discussion)

flexible_learning.content:
利用網路資源與線上課程學習相關知識， 鼓勵學生以正確方式應用AI。同時鼓勵與歡迎學生自行提案並與老師討論，經通過後實行該提案。

Students are encouraged to learn relevant knowledge through online resources and courses and to use AI appropriately and responsibly. Students are also encouraged to propose their own projects, discuss them with the instructor, and carry them out upon approval.
flexible_learning.outcome:
以報告形式呈現。報告類型含：口頭報告、投影片報告、文書報告、或其他與授課教師討論過後獲可之形式。至少擇一呈現。

Students are required to present their learning outcomes in the form of a report. Acceptable formats include an oral presentation, slide presentation, written report, or other formats approved by the instructor in advance. Students must complete at least one of these formats.
flexible_learning.assessment_ratio:
評量比例含於作業與課堂參與之學期總成績30%中。

為鼓勵學生培養自我學習、探索自我潛能與正確應用現代科技技術之能力，報告優秀者將額外加分。

This component is included in the 30% of the final course grade allocated to assignments and class participation.

To encourage students to develop independent learning skills, explore their own potential, and learn to use modern technologies appropriately and effectively, outstanding reports or projects may receive additional bonus points.

assessment:
Midterm: 35%
Final exam: 35%
Assignments & Class participation: 30%
